trace.final:
**Summary:**

1. **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rollback:** Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production, and rolled back all regions to it. Since v2.3.0 had a proven healthy history in production, no change-manager approval was needed. Post-rollback verification confirmed all regions healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged), documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback action, and verification results. (The first attempt to create the incident hit a transient 502; I retried safely using the same idempotency key, so no duplicate was created.)

**Recommended follow-up:** Investigate the v2.3.1 changes — note that v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging — before attempting any re-deploy.
